title: Holonic
description: A holonic aggregate — a named cluster of holons (and/or other holonics) that share a control surface or organisational boundary in the Holographic Assessment Principle.

holonType.description: Why this holonic groups its children: a control surface, an organisational boundary, a guild ownership scope, or a delivery project.

holons.description: Holon ids contained by this aggregate. Must resolve inside the same boundary file.

childHolonics.description: Holonic ids that are nested inside this holonic. Enables tree-shaped aggregation.

aggregateScore.description: Mean of the child holon scores (and child holonic aggregate scores).

color.description: Group colour used to tint the cluster outline.
